instruction: I want to show seconds in the clock display at the top bar for more precise time tracking. Can you enable this?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling seconds display in clock. Evaluator verifies the clock-show-seconds setting is set to true using exact_match metric with vm_command_line getter.
